data.cloud_pin_rules: PIN rules from the cloud record

data_description.cloud_pin_rules: Checks the PIN length against the lock's cloud record, refuses every action when the record shows no keypad, and refuses a set or clear at the master code's slot the record names. When no loaded Yale Home integration holds the lock's record with its capabilities, the PIN is 4 to 8 digits and every action is offered.
data_description.slot_field_width: Lets each action take any slot from 1 to 65535 in place of the slot range, and lets the status action read the master code's slot. The set and clear actions still refuse the master code's slot.
data_description.slot_range_source: The source of the range of PIN slots that the set, clear, and status actions accept. Cloud record takes pinSlotMin to pinSlotMax from the lock's cloud record, and falls back to 1 to 250 when no loaded Yale integration holds the lock's record with both values.
data_description.status_result: Adds result to the status action's answer: pin, empty, the name of the lock's refusal, malformed, or timeout. None of these raises an error. credential_exists is null unless the result is pin or empty.
